grh_8cbaf87870d711dea610.title: Best Foot Forward
paragraphs: Prep-school student Bud Hooper jokingly invites movie star Gale Joy to his prom and panics when she unexpectedly accepts, especially because he has lied to his regular girlfriend Helen that he is ill. Gale attends under Helen's name in search of publicity, while the real Helen arrives and the deception erupts into scandal. The principal expels Bud, but Gale protects him by threatening a publicity photograph that would embarrass the school. grh_8c4a45aa4d2687aff2d8.title: The Rudolph Friml Story
paragraphs: This dramatized biography follows Rudolf Friml from a baker's family in Prague, where an unexpected piano awakens his talent, through conservatory training and his early ambitions as a composer. A youthful romance and the guidance of established musicians shape the melodies he later carries to America, where he is first known as a concert pianist and serious composer. A theatrical dispute unexpectedly gives him the chance to write for the stage, leading to successful operettas including The Firefly and later works remembered throughout the program.
